info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Manage Collaterals API
info.description: The Manage Collaterals API enables financial institutions to update the details of collaterals associated with specific loan applications. Users can leverage this endpoint to ensure that collateral information is accurate and up-to-date, reflecting any changes in asset value or borrower circumstances. This API is particularly useful for loan officers and compliance teams involved in the loan management process. By maintaining precise collateral records, organizations can enhance risk assessment and decision-making in lending operations.

put.description: This endpoint allows you to update the collateral information associated with a specific loan application. Ensure that you provide the necessary data in the request body to reflect the changes required for the collateral.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the collateral details for a specific loan application identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the information provided is complete and accurate to facilitate the processing of the update.
